content: The concept of message passing over graphs has been around for many years BIBREF0, BIBREF1, as well as that of graph neural networks (GNNs) BIBREF2, BIBREF3. However, GNNs have only recently started to be closely investigated, following the advent of deep learning. Some notable examples include BIBREF4, BIBREF5, BIBREF6, BIBREF7, BIBREF8, BIBREF9, BIBREF10, BIBREF11, BIBREF12. These approaches are known as spectral. Their similarity with message passing (MP) was observed by BIBREF9 and formalized by BIBREF13 and BIBREF14.
